text.description_html:
Fusion RH-G1-ORB, Arched Sandcast Brass Hook

Ready to get organized? A few well-placed Rock Ridge Arched Robe Hooks can turn your mess into something to blog about. Hang a few near the font door for bags and winter gear. How about put one in the bathroom for your robe? You can even put one in your closet to organize your purses, ties, or statement jewelry. This beautiful hook comes in the ever-popular oil rubbed bronze finish.

Also Available Matching: Fusion TB-G1 Rock Ridge Towel Bar, Fusion PH-G1 Rock Ridge Toilet Paper Holder, and Fusion TR-G1 Rock Ridge Towel Ring

Features and Specifications of the Fusion Rock Ridge Sandcast Brass Scalloped Robe Hook:

  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Mount Width: 2-7/8"
  • Mount Length: 3-5/8"
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
